method: Added one PointLight to each named Neon Noyau on the three replicated models and three server import prototypes. In Play opened the real armory with a temporary self-destroying server probe, inspected its client ViewportFrames, then called the actual WeaponVisuals.Build for each final weapon and destroyed those temporary clones.
limits: No usable Studio pixel capture was available; the test proves runtime light instances and settings, not rendered appearance or whether the glow is visually strong enough.
The player remained equipped with Fists; this did not equip a final weapon on the character or verify first-/third-person pixels.
No mobile, controller, multiplayer, saved .rbxl, or published-place validation was performed.
cleanup: Stopped Play and returned to Edit. No purchase, grant, profile progression, DataStore write, place save, or publish.
